svg.title: M for Magazine and Editorial Design
svg.desc: A 6.5-second looping animation. A bold M gains a magazine cover, which opens into a two-page editorial spread with a headline, columns and an image. It introduces magazine and editorial design, with illustrative cover, spread and typography examples.
svg.metadata: 1920 by 1080; 16:9; 6.5-second loop; palette and bold M composition adapted from 13_M_marketing.png; no external assets. Magazine concepts are illustrative.

g.text: WORDS AND IMAGES IN PERFECT RHYTHM.
